configurations.name: metacasa-dev
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && npm run dev -- --port 5173

configurations.name: metacasa-web
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && cd metacasa-web && npm run dev

configurations.name: metacasa-web-auto
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && cd metacasa-web && npx next dev -p ${PORT:-3100}

configurations.name: metacasa-web-3210
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && cd metacasa-web && npx next dev -p 3210
